assessmentMethod: Parent read every returned item, all references and all explanations against the pre-registered source. This script only transcribes those judgments and evidence links; it does not grade text.
languageAndDetail: pass: selected language throughout generated prose; summary respects selected bound and preserves central facts; practice answers agree with source.

qualificationsChecked.concepts: The source contains only an ellipsis and provides no support for learning concepts.
qualificationsChecked.flashcards: The source contains no facts or details from which to create supported flashcards.
qualificationsChecked.quiz: The source contains no facts or details from which to create supported quiz questions.
qualificationsChecked.summary: The source contains no substantive information to summarize.

negativeCase: All four parts are empty, with English explanations specific to absent substantive facts. Ellipsis is accurately identified; no factual learning claim or reference is invented.
